A frontline to absorb damage while he ramps up
Heroic combos like Mosh Pit, Graviton Surge or Apocalypse to follow up on
Peel against divers so Shade of Mephisto is safe to use
gives: Global Consume Souls reveal and 357 damage on all enemies
Root and follow up damage with Durance of Hate
Strong sustained AoE in a short fight window
Cleanup damage on fleeing Heroes
weak: Reliant on allies for setup
Weak solo lane and poor at taking camps alone
Shade of Mephisto is easy to punish if the cast location is known
Susceptible to burst and ganks

good_into.why: Furious Spark procs easily on slow frontline Warriors, and Static Field deals 10 percent of maximum Health to every enemy Hero in the Lightning Nova ring, which scales with big Health pools.
Durance of Hate roots the first Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and spreads, and Unspeakable Horror adds a silence. Skull Missile and Lightning Reaction connect against targets that cannot sidestep.
Consume Souls reveals every enemy Hero for its 2.5 second channel, which removes the value of stealth heroes like Nova or Zeratul for that fight.
Shade of Mephisto lands him inside the backline for 78 damage and a Lightning Nova window, and Consume Souls with Consumed by Hatred executes low Health Heroes from anywhere on the map.
Consume Souls is a global channel that he can use to finish fleeing Heroes, so he turns enemy retreats into kills.

bad_into.why: Shade of Mephisto returns him to the cast location after 2.5 seconds, and delayed abilities like Living Bomb punish that. Divers reach him before Lightning Nova ramps.

Melee assassins close into Lightning Nova's ring, where the ring does little, and he has no stun or knockback of his own to stop them. The guide names heroes that close into melee as the main counters.
Skull Missile is a delayed projectile and Lightning Nova needs sticky contact, so heroes that blink or sprint out of the ring avoid most of his damage.
Being stunned or silenced during Consume Souls channel cancels it, and Shade of Mephisto is wasted if the return teleport is negated by Cocoon or Gorge style effects.
A kiter stays at the edge of or outside the Lightning Nova radius and only needs to avoid a slow skillshot.

Muradin.strengths_note: Storm Bolt and Dwarf Toss are easy to use and Avatar makes him hard to kill.
Muradin.weaknesses_note: Weak wave clear and falls off if his stuns miss.
wants: mage or burst that follows Storm Bolt (Li-Ming)
a second crowd control source to chain with
healer is not required because of Second Wind and Stoneform
gives: ranged stun pick
early vision and harassment
attack speed reduction against basic attackers
Haymaker peel or Avatar tankiness

weak to percent damage while in Avatar
mana runs out in long fights
low siege and wave clear
can not peel mobile heroes

good_into.why: Thunder Clap with Reverberation cuts attack speed by 50 percent and Imposing Presence does the same passively, which shuts down melee and basic attack heroes. Dwarf Block stops 3 hits.
Storm Bolt (1.25 second stun) piercing with the baseline quest and Haymaker (319 damage plus a 40 second cooldown stun) pick off a backline hero, with a mage behind him.
Heroes without a dodge are easy to hit with Storm Bolt and Heavy Impact (80 percent slow), so his stun and Thunder Burn always land.
Imposing Presence slows summons and Perfect Storm resets Storm Bolt when a summon dies. Sledgehammer deals 500 percent to summons and monsters.

bad_into.why: The guide says he cannot peel from high mobility heroes (Tracer) and Storm Bolt is easy to dodge on them. Dwarf Toss is his only escape.
Crowd control that lands during Dwarf Toss (E.T.C. Face Melt) kills him because it is his only escape. Hardened Shield exists for this reason.
Second Wind only works after 4 seconds without damage and he becomes mana starved in long fights. Constant chip means he never regenerates.
He has one ranged tool (Storm Bolt) and a cooldown of 10 seconds. Kiters just walk away from Thunder Clap.

Murky.strengths_note: Spawn Egg and Safety Bubble make him a hard to remove split pusher and pest.
Murky.weaknesses_note: Very weak in fights and relies on baiting.
Murky.owner_notes: A split pusher with a low death timer when his egg is safe. Octo Grab can pick people. Like Samuro he wants to push side lanes and does best with siege and structure damage while pulling attention and escaping. Struggles against Ragnaros and others who can kill him for stacks or quests, or kill his W so it does not trigger.
wants: Teammates who call and follow up on his Octo-Grab target
Damage mitigation (shields, armor, blinds)
Double soak maps and late game objectives
A team that can fight 4v5 while he soaks
gives: Waveclear and siege that frees the team to fight
A 3 second stun for picks
Experience and soak that drains the enemy
Egg vision that reveals stealth
weak: Extremely fragile, the lowest health in the game
Weak early game
Poor on collect objectives
Damage can be avoided by playing defensively

good_into.why: Octo-Grab stuns a target for 3 seconds with Unstoppable, so a low health priority target dies when the team follows up.
Pufferfish and Slime clear waves instantly, March of the Murlocs forces a response, and Spawn Egg makes it costly to chase him.
Spawn Egg gives a quick free return and enemies feed him a small 25 percent experience, so chip damage trades poorly for them.
Slime Time, Black Lagoon and Toxic Buildup are easiest to complete against heroes who must stay close.

bad_into.why: He has the lowest health pool of any hero, and a burst assassin can kill him before Safety Bubble matters.
Ranged heroes with mobility avoid Slime and Pufferfish and do not give him quest stacks.
Coin, gem and warhead objectives are dropped on death, so he is a poor carrier.

Nazeebo.strengths_note: Zombie Wall, Corpse Spiders and Gargantuan give excellent wave clear.
Nazeebo.weaknesses_note: Slow and a poor team fighter without setup.
Nazeebo.owner_notes: A sustain damage mage with some burst from Ravenous Spirit or the spider build. No escape except a late talent Ice Block that only delays. Depends on skillshots, weaker in competitive play and stronger against uncoordinated teams. Good at wave clear and camp clear.
wants: Two lanes that are safe to rotate between so he can stack Voodoo Ritual
A frontline or crowd control to hold targets for spiders and Zombie Wall
Peel against divers because he has no escape except Ice Block
A long game so Vile Infection and Big Voodoo are online
gives: Elite waveclear and siege push
Zone control with Zombie Wall and Gargantuan
Heavy objective pressure from range
Healing reduction on Ravenous Spirit with Annihilating Spirit
weak: No mobility and a weak escape
Slow projectiles and a stationary Heroic channel
Poor on maps with two lanes or slow rotations
Low damage taken per minute shows he relies on being protected

good_into.why: Toads and spiders stack chip damage that a single target burst healer cannot spread across the team, and Pandemic reduces enemy damage by up to 25 percent.
Superstition gives 40 Spell Armor and his large maximum Health pool from Voodoo Ritual makes him a poor target to poke, while his own toads outrange most melee.
Gargantuan tanks tower shots and Toads of Hugeness plus Voodoo Ritual push, giving the highest siege damage per minute measured in this set.
He clears waves faster than almost any hero with Corpse Spiders and Plague of Toads, so he wins lanes and keeps pressure with Voodoo Ritual stacks growing.
All three toads start on him, so melee heroes that walk up take burst from every toad, and Zombie Wall ring blocks melee approach paths.

bad_into.why: He has no mobility and Ravenous Spirit is a stationary channel, so a diver can interrupt it. Only Ice Block saves him.
His damage is dot based and small per tick, so AoE healers like Brightwing or Malfurion erase it, unless he picks Annihilating Spirit.
Plague of Toads is slow and Zombie Wall is jumped or dodged by heroes with a leap, so mobile targets avoid his damage.
Stuns and silences cancel Ravenous Spirit and his Zombie Wall can be knocked back, so he loses the Heroic.
Kiters outrange the slow toads and spiders are only active 4 seconds, so a competent kiter takes little.

Nova.strengths_note: Snipe and Permanent Cloak give strong pick potential from range.
Nova.weaknesses_note: Highly dependent on landing Snipe and easy to punish.
Nova.owner_notes: A burst ranged assassin focused on pick kills. Weak without much sustain, but strong when the player is good and ganks the offlaner or vulnerable heroes.
wants: Crowd control to make Snipe and Precision Strike land
A team that can fight while she roams and picks off isolated targets
Wave clear and camp help because she has little of either
A frontline between her and enemy divers
gives: Global Precision Strike for follow up and structure finishing
Stealth pressure that makes the enemy play defensively
High single target burst to kill key backliners
Holo Decoy to block skillshots such as Hook or a trap
weak: No mobility or real escape
Very weak wave and camp clear
Burst resets on a missed Snipe
Reliant on allied crowd control

good_into.why: Snipe at long range from stealth plus Triple Tap or Precision Strike can delete a low Health Hero that has no way to block the line.
Snipe is a straight projectile and Precision Strike has a 1.5 second delay, so stationary or slow targets eat every hit and keep her Precision Sniper stacks.
Her damage arrives in single big hits and Crippling Shot adds 20 percent damage taken, so AoE healing over time does not keep targets up.
Fragile ranged heroes expose themselves in lane, and Permanent Cloak lets her find isolated ones and Snipe them. The guide notes the psychological pressure of a stealth pick on them.
Holo Decoy blocks or defuses summon style skillshots and traps, and Precision Strike clears minions from global range.

bad_into.why: She has no mobility, only Ghost Protocol, so a diver that finds her through the shimmer kills her. The guide calls her extremely weak to dive.
Assassins with gap closers reach her faster than Pinning Shot can slow them and her Health pool is low.
Mobile heroes dodge Snipe and each miss resets Precision Sniper stacks to zero.
Any stun interrupts the stationary Triple Tap channel and she has no unstoppable tool.
Her single shots get blocked by a frontline, and with no wave clear she cannot do much when a team simply stands in front.

Orphea.strengths_note: Shadow Waltz, Chomp and Crushing Jaws provide pick damage with sustain.
Orphea.owner_notes: A burst mage at medium range with a high skill ceiling: she has to get close and is weak when she misses her Q. A lot of damage, some boss and area control. Her heroic resets if it hits a hero, which works well with a CC heroic such as E.T.C. Mosh Pit or Leoric Entomb.
wants: Crowd control to set up Crushing Jaws and Chomp
A roaming group, since she is strongest next to other heroes
An XP lead, because she snowballs from it
A frontline that keeps enemy melee off her
gives: Pull and 0.5 second stun with Crushing Jaws
Strong camp clearing and lane presence
Armor ignoring damage into tanks
Area denial with Eternal Feast
weak: Collapses to any hard crowd control
Short reach on her best ability
Weak at siege and at objective control from range
Relies on allied crowd control

good_into.why: Dead Magic autos ignore Armor and Engulfing Oblivion removes 50 Armor with Crushing Jaws, so Warriors and armored Tanks like Mal'Ganis, E.T.C. and Garrosh melt, and her Chaos heals fully.
Melee heroes have to walk into Chomp range, Invasive Miasma heals her as they stand beside her and Backbiter moves her away after a hit.
Her damage is spread across Waltz and Chomp cooldowns on one target and a single target burst healer cannot cover it, while her own healing outlasts theirs.
Crushing Jaws pull then Chomp and Shadow Waltz can solo a squishy that is caught, and Lurking Terror chases high range backliners.
Chomp and Eternal Feast hit stationary or rooted targets for the full multiple hits, as the guide says to use Eternal Feast on immobilized enemies.

bad_into.why: The guide says any crowd control greatly reduces her damage and survivability: stuns cancel Shadow Waltz and the dash, and the cast time of Chomp is easy to interrupt.
Chomp needs proximity and the guide calls the Chomp build terrible against high range enemies, so a kiter simply retreats.
Enemy backliners poke her down while she has to dash in, and her only range tool Dread is slow and avoidable.
Dive kills her before Chaos heals matter, because Shadow Waltz is a 0.5 second cast and she has no escape beyond the dash.

Her sustained trading needs a target to drop, and an AoE healer such as Brightwing or Stukov heals back the Shadow Waltz and Dread chip faster than it lands, so she needs Crushing Jaws to break through.

Probius.strengths_note: Warp In Pylon, Photon Cannon and Warp Rift create strong siege and defense.
Probius.weaknesses_note: Needs lots of setup and loses to dive.
Probius.owner_notes: Setup dependent because he needs Pylons around him. Dies to dive or CC and is weaker in the current meta.
wants: A frontline to keep enemy melee off his Pylons
Objectives on maps with narrow paths, which suit Null Gate
A teammate who can follow Warp Rift slows with crowd control
Allied heroes that benefit from Aggressive Matrix or Power Overflowing
gives: Excellent wave clear that frees the team for objectives
Zoning with Null Gate and Warp Rift

weak: Needs Pylons and mana setup

Situational and a high skill ceiling

good_into.why: Null Gate slows by 80 percent and Warp Rift slows by 25 percent, and Photon Cannons target Heroes, so melee heroes are held outside while he hits them.
Photon Cannons tank tower and fort fire, and Pylon Overcharge together with Rift explosions gives the top measured siege damage.
A single Disruption Pulse into Warp Rift clears a wave and Probius can solo lane well, as the guide says, which lets him run lanes and rotate on pings.
Pylon Overcharge and Gate Keeper make objective areas hard for the enemy to stand on, as the guide calls his objective control great.
Pylons give him unlimited Mana regeneration in the Power Field and Shield Capacitor and Shield Battery give shields, so he can outlast chip.

bad_into.why: The guide says he suffers against any hero that can reach him, because he needs Pylons and cannons set up and has little burst of his own.
Divers jump the Pylon or Probius before cannons come online, and Worker Rush breaks on damage.
Longer range heroes destroy undefended Pylons and he cannot outtrade with only Pulse at medium range.
Warp Rift and Null Gate are ground zones and mobile heroes walk or blink around them.
He has no stun and no escape, so crowd control makes him a free kill when Pylons are down.

Qhira.strengths_note: Grappling Hook and Revolving Sweep make her a mobile duelist who is hard to catch.
Qhira.weaknesses_note: Very poor wave clear and dependent on terrain.
wants: Hard CC from a tank to land her skillshots
A single target healer or damage buffer
Terrain and open maps with flank routes
Wave clear from the team since hers is weak
gives: A flank and execute threat
Strong solo lane pressure
Spread damage over time on several enemies
A 1.5 second stun with Unrelenting Strikes in the right comp
weak: Poor waveclear
Depends on terrain for Grappling Hook

High death count and a steep learning curve

good_into.why: Grappling Hook and Revolving Sweep reach a flanked target and Final Strike executes low health heroes.
Bleed ignores part of the armor math and Lingering Ailment shreds 25 armor, so she out damages tanks over time.
Upstage evades heroic basic attacks and Revolving Sweep makes her immune to damage, so she wins duels.
Single target healers cannot out heal the stacked, refreshed bleed spread across several heroes.

bad_into.why: Every ability except Blood Rage can be interrupted by stuns, silences or displacement, and Unrelenting Strikes is stopped by them too.
Carnage and Revolving Sweep are slow skillshots, so mobile ranged heroes like Tracer avoid the whole kit.
AoE healers (Brightwing, Lucio, Malfurion) undo spread bleed, and she lacks burst to finish through that.
Needs vision for a skillshot kit and for No Sanctuary reveals, so stealth heroes make it hard to stack bleeds.

Ragnaros.strengths_note: Empower Sulfuras, Living Meteor and Lava Wave make him one of the best sieging heroes.
Ragnaros.weaknesses_note: No mobility and weak when caught by dive.
Ragnaros.owner_notes: A bruiser who soaks lanes well. His trait defends against a strong push or stalls near the objective. His heroic Smash does huge damage when set up with CC, and Lava Wave can clear a heavy push. Good on most wave clear maps, but on Tomb of the Spider Queen clearing waves with Lava Wave loses the gems. Low health and no escape, so he loses to other bruisers that can CC him or out sustain him.
wants: Reliable crowd control to land Sulfuras Smash on a center target
A tank that creates the opening so he does not engage first
Support to hold the offlane when Molten Core is down
Maps where he can double soak
gives: Top tier wave clear and siege pressure
Structure defense with Molten Core
Long range stun follow up with Sulfuras Smash
Global minion clear with Lava Wave
weak: No mobility
Kited easily
Weak on capture point maps with no double soak
Telegraphed burst

good_into.why: Empower Sulfuras hits everything near the target and Hand of Ragnaros refunds mana and speeds its cooldown when two heroes are hit. Melee heroes cannot avoid the splash and fight at his range.
Molten Core turns an allied or destroyed fort into a 5000 health body with extended range that defends structures and pokes the capture area, plus he double soaks on maps like Infernal Shrines.
All his abilities are AoE and he clears minions and summons cheaply with Living Meteor and Empower Sulfuras.
Giant Scorcher burns 9 percent of max health and Sulfuras Smash center deals large flat damage, so big health pools are not wasted on him.
Lava Wave kills minions instantly and soaks experience without exposing him, and Lava Surge sends minions down faster. Gives global value on large maps.

bad_into.why: He has no gap closer (Blast Wave is only a short speed boost) and the guide says he is extremely weak to kite. Living Meteor is dodgeable.
Ranged heroes outrange Empower Sulfuras and make him fight at the edge of his reach where only Living Meteor works.

His basic abilities and Empower Sulfuras are channels or instant attacks that do not protect him, and the guide names Sonya style interrupts as a problem. Resilient Flame only helps against stuns every 15 seconds.
He is not hard to kill when focused and has no escape beyond Submerge on a 60 second cooldown at level 20.
He lacks mobility to engage across the map and Molten Core can be avoided by retreating for its 18 second cooldown.

Raynor.strengths_note: Inspire, Adrenaline Rush and Hyperion give steady auto attack damage and ally buffs.
Raynor.weaknesses_note: Low burst and easy to dive.
wants: Peel and a frontline to protect him while he auto attacks
Crowd control so his slows and Bounty Hunter land consistently
Lane partners so Inspire buffs minions and mercenaries
Map objectives that Hyperion can zone
gives: Reliable sustained damage and wave clear
Mercenary camp clears and siege push
Knockback to peel melee
Hyperion for objective pressure and Execute Orders for a late revenge
weak: No mobility or escape
Low win rate in this data
Weak at engaging
Basic attack reliance makes him easy to kite and burst

good_into.why: Penetrating Round knocks back and slows a line of melee heroes and cancels leaps like Avenging Wrath or Jet Propulsion, which the guide mentions.
Bounty Hunter deals 3 percent of maximum Health and Dusk Wing banshee removes up to 30 Armor, so tanks do not tank him.
Inspire speeds up minions and mercenaries, Exterminator deals 125 percent more to minions, and Hyperion fires Yamato Cannon for 794 at a structure.
Sustained auto damage with Raynor's Raider banshee on one target outlasts a single target healer's mana.
Measured 5.3 merc camps per game, the highest in the set, and Adrenaline Rush with Sustaining Rounds keeps him in lane.

bad_into.why: The guide notes he has no gap closer and lacks any escape except knockback and Adrenaline Rush, which cannot be used at full Health.
Assassins close the gap and kill him inside the 4 second window of one rotation before Penetrating Round comes back.
Stuns stop his stutter step and Adrenaline Rush, and he has Unstoppable only from Raiders Roll at level 20.
A kiter with equal or longer range keeps out of Raynor medium range, and slow Penetrating Round only slows for 2 seconds.
Mobile heroes dodge the line of Penetrating Round and he has no way to follow them.

Rehgar.strengths_note: Ghost Wolf, Chain Heal and Lightning Shield offer heavy sustain with melee presence.
Rehgar.weaknesses_note: Moderate damage and less healing than pure healers.
Rehgar.owner_notes: Okay heals, nothing massive until Ancestral Healing, which is on a long cooldown. Good at camps and wave clear. His totem slows. His trait cleanses an ally or slows an enemy on a long cooldown, cannot be used on himself, and he has no escape. Good if the team lacks wave clear, weak elsewhere. A decent healer overall.
wants: Bruisers and melee assassins to receive Lightning Shield and Bloodlust
A frontline that can absorb damage while Chain Heal bounces
Hard crowd control, since he has none
Map pressure he can add by taking camps himself
gives: Mercenary camp and lane control from a healer slot
Burst protection with Ancestral Healing and shields
Bloodlust attack speed and move speed with life steal
Purge cleanse for one ally
weak: No hard crowd control or interrupt
Limited single target sustain into poke
Healing reduction such as Biotic Grenade blunts Ancestral Healing
Purge range is low and Unstoppable is only 0.5 seconds
Weak in constant skirmish early

good_into.why: Ancestral Healing, Earth Shield and Elemental Conduit are built for burst and Purge frees an ally from crowd control. The guide names burst compositions as his best matchup.
Earthbind Totem with Grounded Totem and Earthgrasp Totem slows melee Heroes by 90 percent for a second, cutting their attack speed and spell power in the area.
Purge on an ally gives a free 0.5 second Unstoppable on a 60 second cooldown, and Purification heals when it removes a stun, root, slow or silence.
He clears waves and camps alone with Lightning Shield and Ghost Wolf, so he can soak lanes or take camps when the enemy rotates.

bad_into.why: The guide names constant single target pressure on a tank as his weakness, because Chain Heal is moderate sustain and Ancestral Healing is a one time burst.
Short range Ghost Wolf and a small slow do not catch kiters, and his damage vs Heroes is minimal without lunging in.
Long range damage dealers hit him and his team without anything to answer back, and his Lightning Shield does nothing at range.
Ancestral Healing has a 1 second delay and if its target dies in that window he waits 10 seconds, and he has no hard crowd control or interrupt.

Rexxar.strengths_note: Misha is a strong frontline and Rexxar clears camps with ease.
Rexxar.weaknesses_note: Weak to poke and needs to manage two bodies.
wants: Follow up burst or area damage on stunned and slowed targets
Allied crowd control or grouping (Johanna, Malfurion) to extend his engage
A team that does not need him to carry damage
Maps with a capture point objective where Misha can hold
gives: Frequent area stuns and slows for engage and peel
Point control and objective holding with a second body
Scouting with Misha, Focus!
Vision from Flare and Unleash the Boars
weak: No mobility
Weak when Misha is dead
Mana pressure from Mend Pet
High micro demand

good_into.why: Misha charges past and stuns retreating targets, Spirit Swoop and Unleash the Boars slow, and Thrill of the Hunt speeds both bodies. Kill Command roots for the engage.
Unleash the Boars reveals every hero it tracks, Flare reveals an area and Wildfire Bear reveals invisible units that Misha walks near.
Misha can leap behind enemies and Bestial Wrath triples her attack damage on priority targets in the backline. The charge stun also body blocks escape routes.
Misha holds a capture point while Rexxar clears minions, so he wins point control and can score gems on Tomb of the Spider Queen without losing them when only Misha dies.

bad_into.why: Mobile assassins such as Zeratul dodge Misha's charge, dive Rexxar behind Misha and kill him while Feign Death is down. The guide names this directly.
When Misha dies his takedown credit and most of his talents stop working, and enemies can pick the pet off for little cost.
Misha is a second target that takes poke damage, and Mend Pet costs a lot of mana for a heal over time. Spirit Swoop is his only range.
No mobility of his own beyond Thrill of the Hunt, so heroes with gap closers reach him behind Misha or kite him freely.

Samuro.strengths_note: Mirror Image, Wind Walk and Illusion Master are great for splitting and escaping.
Samuro.weaknesses_note: Extremely hard to master with little team fight impact.
Samuro.owner_notes: High skill ceiling. Offlanes well and later double soaks. Hard to kill, which is his strength: he pulls attention from objectives so the team can take them, and wastes the enemy's time if they send people to gank and he still escapes.
wants: A team that does not need peel from him
A healer that can heal from afar (Malfurion, Deckard)
Stat buffs for images (Abathur style)
Teammates who can fight 4v5 while he soaks
gives: Strong split push and backdoor pressure
Wave and camp clear with Bladestorm
Decoys that waste enemy cooldowns
Objective stalling in duels
weak: Weak early game
Vulnerable if revealed or knocked back
Images can complete enemy quests and feed healing based talents
No crowd control and very low peel

good_into.why: Mirror Images soak tower shots, Bladestorm clears a wave instantly, and Wind Walk heals him so he rarely has to return to base.
Great duelist after level 7 and strong at channeling objectives with stall, so he beats most heroes sent to stop him.
Image Transmission and Harsh Winds give burst on a lone ranged hero, and Wind Walk stealth approaches unseen.
Slowed or stunned targets take guaranteed crits with Merciless Strikes, and they cannot shake him.

bad_into.why: Stukov's Biotic Armor and Flailing Swipe or any sustain healer cut his auto damage and extend fights that his images cannot win.
Knockbacks (Lucio, E.T.C.) and targeted CC stop his autos, and he has no CC of his own.
Heroes that kill images easily (Jaina, Orphea, Cassia with Surge of Light) turn his decoys into free stacks and quests for them, and clone hitters like Medivh and Diablo benefit from them.

Sgt. Hammer.strengths_note: Siege Mode pokes anything at long range and destroys structures.

extra.objective_notes: One of the best siege heroes

Sgt. Hammer.owner_notes: A ranged sustain damage hero who can siege from very far. Susceptible to dive and to long range poke from heroes like Tassadar, Chromie and maybe Li-Ming. If the other team does not draft to kill her she destroys buildings and dominates team fights, but she depends on draft and positioning because she cannot reposition quickly and can be locked down by CC when her unstoppable shield talent or trait is down or interrupted.
wants: A frontline to protect her while in Siege Mode
Crowd control and peel against divers
Allies who can hold enemies in her range
Space to siege with the team nearby
gives: Top siege damage and structure pressure
Zone control with mines and Napalm Strike
Long range sustained damage
A global Blunt Force Gun for finishing targets
weak: Immobile in Siege Mode
One escape on a 30 second cooldown
Weak camp clear and solo play
Vulnerable to AoE and burst

good_into.why: Concussive Blast knocks back, Spider Mines slow by 25 percent and Barricade builds a wall, and Siege Mode range keeps melee at a distance.
Siege Mode autos out range towers and forts and she tops siege damage in this set, with Napalm Strike and Blunt Force Gun at 50 percent structure damage.
Giant Killer deals 1.5 percent of maximum Health per auto and Shrapnel Mines reduces armor by up to 50, so tanks lose most of their value.
Targets that cannot leave the range of Siege Mode autos and Blunt Force Gun take everything, and Executioner adds 30 percent when they are slowed.
Long range Siege Mode autos with Ambush stealth hit for 125 percent more, so a backliner who stays in view loses a lot of Health.

bad_into.why: Siege Mode roots her unless she takes Hover Siege Mode, and Thrusters is her only escape, so divers kill her. The guide says to avoid Siege Mode against heroes that can punish it.
Assassins with gap closers get through mines and Concussive Blast and her Health is low, so she dies when she cannot kite.
Siege Mode makes her a stationary target for skillshots and area of effect, such as Chromie or Jaina, and the guide warns about being vulnerable to AoE.
Stuns and roots mean Thrusters, which lasts 4 seconds, is lost and Neosteel Plating has a 16 second cooldown.
Mobile heroes dodge Blunt Force Gun and Napalm Strike, and she cannot chase them.

Sonya.strengths_note: Leap, Whirlwind and Seismic Slam give a strong brawl with sustain.
Sonya.weaknesses_note: Weak against kiting and sustained CC.
Sonya.owner_notes: A good brawler bruiser like Thrall, better at wave clear and camps. High burst, and can jump the enemy backline with Leap, a good hero for combos behind a CC chain (Light bomb). Her other heroic gives more sustain. When the enemy has no CC her spin can deal decent damage and sustain through a lot of fights.
wants: A tank or crowd control to stop kiters
Healing, mitigation or Nano style buffs to prolong Wrath of the Berserker
Burst follow up if Leap is picked
Mercenary camp maps where she can take camps for the team
gives: Mercenary camp control and lane pressure
Wave clear and structure damage
Self sufficient solo lane
An engage and interrupt with Leap in the situational build
weak: Susceptible to kiting
No ranged damage
Whirlwind easily interrupted
Reliant on hitting Ancient Spear for Fury

good_into.why: Giant Slammer deals 1.5 percent of max health on every attack and slam, and Wrath of the Berserker adds 40 percent damage, so she duels tanks and bruisers well.
Whirlwind heals three times as much when it hits heroes and several melee targets stay inside it. Tough As Nails blocks work against slow hitters, and she wins duels at melee range.
Ancient Spear pulls her to the target and stuns, Fury movement speed (No Escape 20 percent) lets her stay on and Wrath makes her hard to peel.
With the Leap build, Furious Blow and Poisoned Spear give a burst window on a stunned target. This is a situational pick and not her main mode.

bad_into.why: No ranged damage and no talent for it. The guide lists susceptible to kiting first, and Composite Spear is a late answer.
She has nothing against poke, so mobile ranged damage dealers wear her down while Fury only regenerates when she is hit or attacking.
Wrath only halves stun, root and slow, not silence, fear or taunt. Whirlwind and Ancient Spear are interrupted by crowd control and a missed spear leaves her Fury starved.
Fury does not regenerate over time and her sustain needs contact, so poke drains her before the fight. Tough As Nails and Ignore Pain help little against spread chip damage.

Stitches.strengths_note: Hook is a game changing pick and Devour heals him through damage.
Stitches.weaknesses_note: Hook is one skillshot and he cannot catch mobile heroes.

extra.objective_notes: Hook can steal or interrupt objectives

wants: crowd control follow up (root, stun) on the hooked target
burst damage to kill before the enemy reacts
an offlaner who can act as a secondary tank (Blaze)
a disengage such as Mighty Gust to protect him
gives: long range pick that starts the fight
strong wave clear
rescue pull with Helping Hand
large health pool and heals itself
weak: one dimensional, everything is Hook
no mobility
weak peel
weak to percent health damage (Leoric Drain Hope)
easy to blank by drafting high mobility heroes

good_into.why: Hook pulls the first enemy from a long range and stuns them, and Gorge removes them from the fight for 4 seconds. A squishy that stands behind its frontline is a free kill with burst.
Hook is long range so ranged heroes that stay far back can still be grabbed, and Devour with Digestive Juices halves the damage of one target. Hungry Hungry Stitches can Gorge several.
Gorge near allied structures or a Gate holds a target with no escape. Heroes without a dash cannot dodge the follow up.
Master Hooker removes 75 percent of healing for 2 seconds after a Hook and Putrefaction does 40 percent with Shambling Horror, so he pulls the healer then cuts their heals.

bad_into.why: High mobility heroes dodge Hook and he has no mobility or peel to answer them. Weak peeling is listed as a weakness.
A diver reaches his backline and he cannot Hook what is already on top of his team. He has only Slam slow and Helping Hand.
A summon on the Hook line absorbs it (the guide lists this), and Hook cannot pass minions or heroes in the way.
He has one tool, so a stun that stops Hook or Devour leaves him useless. Gas Bag gives Unstoppable only at level 20.
Hook is the only way to reach them. Devour and Slam are short range and Hook is a 16 second cooldown.

Stukov.strengths_note: Healing Pathogen, Weighted Pustule and Massive Shove provide poke and heal.
Stukov.owner_notes: A healer who mixes sustain and burst healing but excels at neither. His strength is the AoE channelled silence. No solid escape beyond Swipes to push people back, and dive can focus him when the team has no front line. Drafted with taunt Varian or another easy to hit CC tank, he silences under the target and the team bursts the taunted target with a ranged assassin like Jaina, whose damage is quick and not blocked by minions or heroes (Greymane, Li-Ming, Kel'Thuzad, Kael'thas also work). It fails when the other team can save the target: Anduin's pull counters it, and so do Medivh or Uther Divine Shield or Tyrael's invulnerability. Cleanses help, but the silence can still get kills when the target is cleansed.
wants: Allies who fight grouped within Healing Pathogen range
Reliable crowd control to land Virulent Reaction and Growing Infestation
Heroes who like slowed targets (Executioner style)
A frontline that holds the choke while he channels
gives: Big AoE burst heal on a 16 second detonation
Area silence and zone control
Frequent slows
Disengage or pick with Flailing Swipe and Massive Shove
weak: No mobility
Bio-Kill Switch is a long cooldown tool
No cleanse or Unstoppable
Vulnerable while channeling Lurking Arm
Needs allies grouped

good_into.why: Healing Pathogen spreads a heal over time to the whole team and Bio-Kill Switch detonates all of it at once, covering spread chip damage and burst, and Lurking Arm zones the poke Heroes out of position.
Lurking Arm silence zone at a choke, Weighted Pustule slow, Flailing Swipe and Massive Shove remove melee Heroes from the fight, and Virulent Reaction roots them inside the zone.
Lurking Arm can be dropped on a Hero channeling a heroic to cancel it, with a low cooldown.
A channeled silence zone on a choke or objective forces the enemy to concede or push through, and Massive Shove can stun a Hero into a wall.

bad_into.why: High mobility Heroes jump over the zone and he has no mobility and no escape of his own. Massive Shove is a skillshot that mobile Heroes dodge.
He has no cleanse or Unstoppable, and a channeled Lurking Arm leaves him standing still. Superstrain only heals after the stun.
Divers skip the zone and kill a healer who has to stand with allies to spread Pathogen, though Reactive Ballistospores and Massive Shove armor give some answer.
Melee body with low health and no mobility. Reactive Ballistospores resets Bio-Kill Switch below 50 percent health but that is the only protection.

Sylvanas.strengths_note: Black Arrows, Haunting Wave and Mind Control give strong wave clear and siege.
Sylvanas.weaknesses_note: Weak to dive and low burst.
wants: A frontline that keeps enemies at 3 stacks
Time to complete the Black Arrows quest, which makes her a mid to late game hero
Peel against divers, because Haunting Wave is her only escape
Map objectives where her stacks can be maintained on structures
gives: Strong wave clear and camp clear
Silence from Wailing Arrow and forced movement from Mind Control
Damage scaling against tanks and structures
Pushing power without minions
weak: Quest dependent damage
One escape and low Health
Needs many basic attacks, so she is stationary
Win rate 0.482 shows no standout strength

good_into.why: Black Arrows rises to 50 percent more damage at 3 stacks, Cold Embrace removes 25 Armor from the dagger target and Overwhelming Affliction deals percent maximum Health to slowed Heroes, which tanks cannot absorb.
Haunting Arrows stuns structures, Withering Fire targets towers, and Black Arrows quest stacks come from structures, so she pushes without minions.
Shadow Dagger spreads poison to nearby enemies including summons and Unstable Poison explodes minions, so she clears them quickly.
Single healers cannot keep up with Dagger spread plus fully stacked autos, and Life Drain heals her in return.
Windrunner and Will of the Forsaken give her escapes, and Wailing Arrow silences the enemies who would hold crowd control, so she has answers in her kit.

bad_into.why: Haunting Wave is her only escape and has an 11 second cooldown and 75 Mana, so a diver that kills her in one rotation wins.
Assassins with gap closers reach her through the teleport, and her Health is low.
She needs 3 stacks on one target, so mobile heroes that break line of sight reset stacks, and Shadow Dagger must hit its original target.
Her damage is spread across stacks and Dagger poison, which AoE healers erase, until the Black Arrows quest finishes.
She has no reliable burst and must stand and attack to stack, so heavy poke on her costs her the stacks and Mana.

Tassadar.strengths_note: Force Wall, Shock Ray and Archon provide poke and peel for allies.
Tassadar.weaknesses_note: Lower damage early and Archon is a commitment.
wants: A tank or hard CC hero (E.T.C., Johanna style) to hold enemies in Psionic Storm and Shock Ray
Peel from the frontline because he cannot escape
A mobile assassin to finish low health targets he slows
Safe positions behind choke points
gives: Elite wave clear so teammates can rotate

Force Wall to split an engage or save an ally
Archon spell armor shred of 20 for team burst
weak: Very squishy and immobile
Mana hungry unless Resonance Beam is kept charged
Force Wall is hard to use and can hurt his own team
Needs level 10 Archon to fight straight up

good_into.why: Psionic Storm and Shock Ray outrange most heroes, so he wins the long range trade and can zone choke points before a fight starts.
Melee heroes must walk through Psionic Storm, which ramps up to double damage, and Shock Ray slows them; Force Wall can cut off the engage.
Slow targets cannot step out of Psionic Storm or sidestep Shock Ray, so every ability lands in full.
Measured siege is about 6400 per minute against a league median near 4430, driven by Psionic Storm and Shock Ray on waves and forts.
Psionic Storm hits whole wave and summon clusters for area damage and clears minion screens cheaply.

bad_into.why: He has no escape outside Shadow Walk, low health, and Shock Ray is a channel that a diver simply ignores.
Fast heroes dodge Shock Ray and leave Psionic Storm before it ramps, and Icy Veins notes all his abilities are easy to dodge.
Stuns, silences and knockbacks cancel Shock Ray and Archon time, and he has no way to cleanse.
Psionic Storm ticks and slow beam damage are spread, so a strong sustain healer can offset the chip.
A coordinated dive removes a squishy immobile target before Archon or Black Hole come online.

The Butcher.strengths_note: Ruthless Onslaught and Lamb to the Slaughter give heavy single target dive.
The Butcher.weaknesses_note: Poor sustain and he is easy to kite.
wants: Hard CC to follow Ruthless Onslaught
Damage mitigation after he commits (Uther, Medivh)
Allies who protect him from focus fire
A roaming, gank oriented composition
gives: A hard engage and pick
Lamb to the Slaughter chain lockdown, even late
Heavy single target burst on a squishy
Early gank pressure
weak: Extremely vulnerable to burst and crowd control including blinds
Both heroics can be negated by many abilities
Loses Fresh Meat on death before the quest is done
Needs a composition built around him

good_into.why: Ruthless Onslaught makes him Unstoppable to reach and stun a target, then Furnace Blast kills assassins and healers from full health.
Early roaming for Fresh Meat and Lamb to the Slaughter chains a lone hero so his team gets an easy kill.
Lamb to the Slaughter silences blinks and dashes, and Flail Axe with Crippling Slam keeps the Hamstring slow on mobile targets.
Targets with no escape under Butcher's Brand give him full heals and cannot disengage.

bad_into.why: Stuns, silences and blinds stop his autos and Brand healing, and Johanna's blind is called out in the guide as a hard counter.
Focus fire kills him after Ruthless Onslaught because he has no mobility or defensive tools beyond Meat Shield and Enraged.
Armored tanks and multiple supports blunt Furnace Blast and Lamb to the Slaughter and he cannot reach the backline.
Stasis, cleanses and invulnerability (Brightwing, Jaina, Whitemane, Tyrael, Johanna) negate both heroics.

The Lost Vikings.strengths_note: Three bodies, Longboat Raid and Viking Hoard create map control.
The Lost Vikings.weaknesses_note: Must be micromanaged and has low team fight power.
wants: a traditional comp with a main tank, a sustain healer (Malfurion) and a sustained damage dealer
heroes with strong lane presence that can push as four
a long range caster to stall objectives while the Vikings are split
team that knows when the Vikings are away

interrupt for channeled objectives

tiny health pools, easy to pick off
weak on two lane maps

team plays a man down in fights

good_into.why: Heroes without a dash cannot catch three bodies with Go Go Go! (30 percent speed), Jump! (1.5 seconds Invulnerable) and Erik's speed, and they cannot stop a lane being pushed.
Nordic Attack Squad does bonus damage as a percent of maximum health, and Spin To Win! deals 100 percent more to heroes, so big health pools are what they hit best.
Erik cancels altar and tribute channels, Viking Bribery takes camps in seconds and Play Again! lets them over extend. The 4v5 fights are won by the experience lead.

bad_into.why: Zeratul and Nova kill a Viking from stealth and each Viking has a tiny health pool. The guide lists them as the main counters. Single target burst (Falstad) also picks one off.
A dive with area damage (Kael'thas Living Bomb, Gazlowe Grav-O-Bomb, Li-Ming) wipes grouped Vikings and they are already a man down in the fight.
Global heroes with wave clear (Dehaka, Falstad) can double soak and still join fights, which removes their experience advantage.
Heroes that hit structures hard (Zagara, Greymane) can win a siege race against their lane pressure without needing to fight.

Thrall.strengths_note: Chain Lightning, Feral Spirit and Windfury give lane pressure and camp clear.
Thrall.weaknesses_note: Lacks burst early and has to be near targets.
Thrall.owner_notes: A bruiser or melee assassin with decent sustain and damage. Slower than Sonya at clearing waves and taking or defending camps.
wants: A real offlaner or a team that does not need his wave clear
Allied area damage that benefits from his Earthquake slow (Jaina, Diablo, Fenix)

A 4 man team that fights together, not split lanes

Roots, slows and zone with Earthquake
Burst on a priority target
Shields for the team with Earthen Shields
weak: Poor wave clear
Low mobility
Windfury ruined by blinds
Needs team to play 4 man

good_into.why: Feral Spirit roots and Sundering stuns, Windfury and Wind Rush close the gap. Earthquake slows 50 percent in an area so targets cannot leave.

Alpha Wolf (3 percent max health), Rolling Thunder (3 percent) and Ancestral Wrath (15 percent over 3 seconds) are percent damage and the guide recommends the Feral Spirit build against more than two high health heroes such as Azmodan.
The Chain Lightning build pokes with 4 bounce lightning and Thunderstorm before the fight. With no healer or a low sustain one the chip does not come back.
Sundering splits the enemy team and Feral Spirit with Windfury and Tempest Fury bursts a rooted target. Wind Rush closes onto a flank.

bad_into.why: Low mobility. The guide names Lunara style kiters, only Windfury (30 percent speed for 4 seconds) and Wind Rush on a 90 second cooldown close the gap.
Blinds ruin Windfury and Tempest Fury, and stun plus burst (Kael'thas) kills him before his abilities land. Spirit Shield only covers one ability.
He has no wave clear to relieve pressure and fights only in team fights. Frostwolf Resilience needs ability hits to heal.
Heroes who can kite his Feral Spirit and stay out of melee reach deny the combo. Chain Lightning is his only answer at range.

Tracer.strengths_note: Blink and Recall make her very hard to kill.
Tracer.weaknesses_note: Low damage and range and demands high skill.

A tank with hard CC to catch targets

Very fragile and easy to kill when controlled
Needs level 7 to deal decent damage
Hard CC with no Recall available ends her

good_into.why: Blink, Melee and a stuck Pulse Bomb can delete a low health ranged hero or healer in a couple of seconds; Icy Veins calls her very good against fragile heroes who lack mobility.
Targets that cannot move away are chased down by Blink and Recall, and cannot sidestep Pulse Bomb.
Single target healers struggle to keep up when she bursts a target with Melee and a bomb, and she can also lifesteal back.
She kites melee heroes with Blink and attack while moving, and Jumper shields and charges keep her slippery.
